source.highlight: FAA ground stop disrupts college football
source.after: Some college football games were delayed a few hours on Saturday or postponed to Sunday. And in Oklahoma at least, there will be perks for fans to make up for the inconvenience, including cheap beers.

source.highlight: Saturday Sports: LIV Golf shuts down; Russian hockey teams banned from World Juniors
source.after: LIV Golf is shutting down after four years and billions of dollars of Saudi investment. Also, Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney says Russian teams cannot play in the World Junior Hockey Tournament.
